name: Better on Paper!
source:
Can you beat procrastination with art forgery?

Help Emie, an adorable girlfailure stay in college long enough to graduate!

Will she pass or will she fail on this harrowing journey of self-discovery, art, friendship and… romance??

[From [url=https://aiainaine.itch.io/better-on-paper]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
靠伪造画作能战胜拖延症吗？

快帮帮惹人怜爱的废柴少女艾米，让她在大学里撑到顺利毕业吧！

在这场关乎自我探索、艺术创作、真挚友情以及……浪漫恋情的揪心旅程中，她究竟能顺利过关，还是会惨遭挂科？？

[摘自[url=https://aiainaine.itch.io/better-on-paper]itch.io[/url]]
